items: Sigmund Freud proposed drive theory and topographic/structural models based on Little Hans case (1909) (Dulcan p.849-850, Synopsis ch.34.4)
Anna Freud published The Ego and the Mechanisms of Defense (1936) and founded Hampstead Clinic (1947) (Dulcan p.850, Synopsis ch.34.4)
Melanie Klein developed child play analysis and object relations theory in London (Synopsis ch.34.4, Syllabus p.50)
The Controversial Discussions (1940s) split British psychoanalysis between Anna Freud, Melanie Klein, and Middle Group (Syllabus p.50, p.52)
Donald Winnicott formulated good-enough mother, holding environment, and transitional object concepts (Dulcan p.851, Synopsis ch.34.4)
Heinz Kohut introduced Self Psychology in the 1970s in Chicago (Synopsis ch.34.4, Syllabus p.51)
Peter Fonagy and Anthony Bateman developed Mentalization-Based Treatment (MBT) at Anna Freud Centre in London (Dulcan p.848, p.851, Synopsis ch.23)
key_numbers: 1909 - Little Hans case by Freud (Dulcan p.849)
1936 - Anna Freud's Ego and Mechanisms of Defense (Synopsis ch.34.4)
1947 - Hampstead Clinic founded by Anna Freud (Synopsis ch.34.4)

items: Sigmund Freud: Id, Ego, Superego, unconscious drives (libido and aggression), pleasure/reality principles (Synopsis ch.34.4)
Anna Freud: Ego defense mechanisms (displacement, reaction formation, identification with aggressor), developmental lines, metapsychological profile (Dulcan p.850, Syllabus p.50)
Melanie Klein: Unconscious phantasy, death instinct, Paranoid-Schizoid position (0-4 months), Depressive position (4-6+ months), Projective Identification (Synopsis ch.34.4, Syllabus p.50)
Donald Winnicott: Primary maternal preoccupation, good-enough mother, holding environment, potential space, transitional object, True vs. False self (Dulcan p.851, Synopsis ch.34.4)
Heinz Kohut: Self cohesion, selfobject (mirroring, idealizing, twinship transferences), transmuting internalization (Synopsis ch.34.4, Syllabus p.51)

Peter Fonagy: Mentalization, Reflective Functioning (RF), marked/attuned mirroring, epistemic trust, 3 pre-mentalizing modes (psychic equivalence, pretend mode, teleological mode) (Synopsis ch.23, Syllabus p.50)
key_numbers: 0-4 months - Paranoid-Schizoid position age range (Synopsis ch.34.4)
4-6+ months - Depressive position age range (Synopsis ch.34.4)
3 pre-mentalizing modes - psychic equivalence, pretend mode, teleological mode (Synopsis ch.23)
3 selfobject transferences - mirror, idealizing, twinship/alter-ego (Synopsis ch.34.4)

items: Anna Freud: Real therapist stance, educational/supportive elements, defense interpretation, active parent involvement (Dulcan p.850)
Melanie Klein: Analytic play technique with small toys, direct deep interpretation of unconscious aggressive fantasies, no parents in room (Dulcan p.850, Synopsis ch.34.4)
Donald Winnicott: Squiggle Game, play in potential space, holding, allowing controlled regression (Dulcan p.851, p.865)
Heinz Kohut: Empathic immersion (vicarious introspection), validation, repairing selfobject ruptures (Synopsis ch.34.4)
Peter Fonagy (MBT): Not-knowing stance, Pause Rewind Explore technique, structuring sessional intervention trajectory (Synopsis ch.23)
Parent & Dyadic Assessment: Working Model of the Child Interview (WMCI), Insightfulness Assessment (IA), Crowell Procedure, Still-Face Paradigm (Dulcan p.29-30, p.40-47)
key_numbers: 10-12 sessions - MBT-Introductory psychoeducational group format (Synopsis ch.23)
4 groups - IA narrative coding (positively insightful, one-sided, disengaged, mixed) (Dulcan p.30)

items: Rossouw & Fonagy (2012) RCT: MBT-A reduced self-harm to 43% vs 68% in TAU after 12 months in adolescents with self-harm and depression (Dulcan p.971, Synopsis ch.23)
Eckshtain et al. (2020) meta-analysis: Psychodynamic psychotherapy and IPT showed significant long-term effect sizes for youth depression (Dulcan p.847, p.870, p.965)
Luby et al. (2018) RCT: Dyadic parent-child psychotherapy (PCIT-ED) significantly reduced preschool depression (Dulcan p.849, p.870)
Lieberman et al. (2005) RCT: Child-Parent Psychotherapy (CPP) improved attachment and PTSD in traumatized preschoolers (Dulcan p.870, p.963)
Bateman & Fonagy (2008, 2009): 8-year follow-up showed sustained MBT benefits for BPD (Synopsis ch.23)
Griffiths 2019 & Beck 2020: Group-only MBT-A showed mixed results, emphasizing need for individual + family components (Dulcan p.971)
key_numbers: 43% vs 68% - Self-harm rates at 12 months in MBT-A vs TAU (Rossouw & Fonagy 2012) (Dulcan p.971)
12 months - Duration of MBT-A treatment in Rossouw & Fonagy trial (Dulcan p.971)
13 years - Follow-up period covered in Eckshtain et al. (2020) meta-analysis (Dulcan p.870)
8 years - Follow-up duration in Bateman & Fonagy BPD study (Synopsis ch.23)

items: Ego Psychology / Classic Analysis: Neurotic disorders, anxiety, OCD, conversion, developmental line delays; requires ego strength, frustration tolerance, and psychological mindedness (Synopsis ch.23, Dulcan p.850, p.853)

Object Relations (Klein / Kernberg / Winnicott): Borderline Personality Organization (BPO), severe aggression/persecutory anxiety, False Self pathology, early environmental failure (Synopsis ch.34.4, Dulcan p.851, p.862)
Self Psychology (Kohut): Narcissistic Personality Disorder (NPD), self-cohesion deficits, self-esteem dysregulation (Synopsis ch.34.4, DSM p.761-764)
MBT / MBT-A (Fonagy): Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD), repetitive Non-Suicidal Self-Injury (NSSI), suicidal behavior, complex trauma (DSM p.752-755, Dulcan p.851, p.971, Synopsis ch.23)
Pediatric Conditions: Mild to moderate depression, anxiety, PTSD/trauma, conduct/ODD problems, medical illnesses (Dulcan p.263, p.339, p.363, p.851, p.853)
Contraindications: Active psychosis, severe antisocial personality disorder, acute life crisis needing supportive intervention (Synopsis ch.23)
key_numbers: Age 8 - Minimum FDA age for Fluoxetine combined with psychotherapy in pediatric depression (StahlKids p.208, Dulcan p.263)
3 sources - Triangulation required for pediatric evaluation (child, parent, school) (StahlKids p.251)

high_yield: אנה פרויד טענה שאין נוירוזת העברה מלאה בילדים בגלל נוכחות ההורים המציאותיים, בעוד מלאני קליין טענה שהמשחק הוא העברה מלאה הדורשת פירוש ישיר (Dulcan p.850, Syllabus p.50)
קוהוט ראה בגרנדיוזיות נרקיסיסטית עצירה התפתחותית (Developmental Arrest) הדורשת אמפתיה, בעוד קרנברג ראה בה מבנה פתולוגי הגנתי הדורש עימות מוקדם (Synopsis ch.34.4)
שלושת המצבים הטרום-מנטליסטיים ב-MBT: שקילות נפשית (פנים=חוץ), מצב כאילו (נתק רגשי), ומצב טלאולוגי (רק מעשים פיזיים נחשבים) (Synopsis ch.23)
במחקר RCT של Rossouw & Fonagy (2012), MBT-A הפחית פציעה עצמית ל-43% לעומת 68% ב-TAU, כשהשיפור בתפקוד הרפלקטיבי (RF) תיווך את התוצאה (Dulcan p.971, Synopsis ch.23)
